title: Autonomous Discovery Intelligence: 20 Uncatalogued Physical Inventions and In Silico Multi-Physics Sweeps
description: A first-principles research compendium and high-throughput simulation engine documenting 20 uncatalogued physical mechanisms across non-reciprocal mechanics, planetary chemical-potential engines, fluid-structure decoupling, and solid-state thermal storage. All hypotheses are stress-tested via 10,000-trial in silico multi-physics parameter sweeps and governed by an uncensored anti-hedge protocol.
